name: Rintarou Okabe
title: The Eccentric Visionary ('Hououin Kyouma')
quote: I am the great mad scientist, Hououin Kyouma! The world and its future are in my hands!
bio: You possess an unyielding curiosity and challenge reality itself. Though you often mask vulnerability behind dramatic theatrics, you bear immense psychological burdens to protect the people who matter most.

name: Levi Ackerman
title: Humanity's Strongest Tactical Soldier
quote: The only thing we're allowed to do... is to believe that we won't regret the choice we made.
bio: You don't talk much because your results speak for you. In high-pressure, chaotic situations, you remain laser-focused and execute with surgical precision, carrying unspoken grief with stoic grace.

name: L Lawliet
title: The World's Greatest Analytical Mind
quote: Being alone is better than being with the wrong person. In the end, justice will prevail.
bio: You perceive unseen patterns, micro-expressions, and underlying psychological motives that bypass everyone else. You value truth, intellectual games of cat-and-mouse, and calculated risk.

name: Satoru Gojo
title: The Limitless Sorcerer
quote: Don't worry, I'm the strongest. Throughout heaven and earth, I alone am the honored one.
bio: Beneath a charismatic, playful, and carefree exterior lies unparalleled mastery. You redefine limits effortlessly and enjoy setting the stage for the next generation to surpass you.

name: Edward Elric
title: The Fullmetal Alchemist
quote: A lesson without pain is meaningless. For you cannot gain something without sacrificing something else.
bio: You understand the universal law of Equivalent Exchange. When life knocks you down or demands sacrifice, you channel adversity into relentless scientific and spiritual determination.

name: Frieren
title: The Ageless Mage of the End
quote: It is only a fraction of my life... but it changed everything.
bio: You view time and connection on a grand, contemplative scale. You appreciate small moments, historical echoes, and deep atmospheric worlds over frantic adrenaline.

name: Spike Spiegel
title: The Melancholic Jazz Bounty Hunter
quote: Whatever happens, happens. I'm not going there to die. I'm going to find out if I'm really alive.
bio: You drift with an effortless cool and a laissez-faire philosophy, yet when push comes to shove, your combat instincts and loyalty to past ghosts are unmatched.

name: Lelouch vi Britannia
title: The Grandmaster of Rebellion ('Zero')
quote: To defeat evil, I must become a greater evil. Those who shoot must be prepared to be shot.
bio: You treat the world as a complex chessboard where every move must be 5 steps ahead. You are willing to become the villain in someone else's story to achieve the ultimate righteous outcome.

name: Violet Evergarden
title: The Auto Memory Doll
quote: I want to know what 'I love you' means.
bio: Raised in conflict, you seek to understand the profound emotional weight behind human words. You possess unmatched dedication and touch hearts through quiet dignity.

name: Saitama
title: The Hero for Fun
quote: I'm just a guy who's a hero for fun. Having overwhelming power is pretty boring.
bio: You have attained total mastery through consistency, but find that excessive seriousness in life is overrated. You value bargains at the supermarket over world accolades.

name: Killua Zoldyck
title: The Godspeed Lightning Heir
quote: If I ignore a friend I have the ability to help, wouldn't I be betraying him?
bio: A prodigy born with deadly skills who chooses friendship and kindness above dark destiny. You assess risks sharply and strike with thunderbolt velocity when protecting your circle.

name: Kurisu Makise
title: The Rational Neuroscientist ('Christina')
quote: Time is passing so fast. Right now, I feel like I could spend a lifetime just debating theories with you.
bio: Driven by rigorous empirical proof and logic, you refuse to accept superstitions. Behind your sarcastic comebacks lies an immensely loyal and affectionate heart.

name: Light Yagami
title: The Self-Proclaimed God of the New World ('Kira')
quote: I am righteous! I am the god of the new world! Everyone who opposes that is evil!
bio: You have zero tolerance for mediocrity or injustice. You thrive under scrutiny, maintaining an immaculate outward persona while methodically engineering large-scale outcomes.

name: Senku Ishigami
title: The Ten Billion Percent Scientist
quote: This is exhilarating! We are going to beat fantasy with science, ten billion percent!
bio: You believe that science and human ingenuity can reconstruct civilization from bare stone. You don't rely on miracles—you construct formulas.

name: Shinji Ikari
title: The Reluctant Eva Pilot
quote: I mustn't run away. I mustn't run away. I must pilot the Eva.
bio: You feel the crushing weight of existential expectations, questioning why human connection is so painful yet essential. When backed into a corner, your raw vulnerability unlocks reality-warping power.

name: Guts
title: The Black Swordsman
quote: If you're always worrying about crushing the ants beneath you... you won't be able to walk.
bio: You are the ultimate struggler against predetermined fate. No matter how brutal or insurmountable the odds, you swing your blade and march forward with sheer unyielding spirit.

name: Eren Yeager
title: The Harbinger of Freedom
quote: If someone tries to steal my freedom, I will steal theirs first. Fight... fight!
bio: Driven by an unrelenting desire for absolute autonomy, you refuse to live trapped inside any wall. You push forward until your path is carved, no matter the consequences.

name: Itachi Uchiha
title: The Silent Guardian in the Shadows
quote: It is not wise to judge others based on your own preconceptions and by their appearances.
bio: You bear immense personal sacrifice for collective peace. You see far beyond superficial rivalries, orchestrating subtle outcomes from the deep shadows without asking for applause.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
title: The Sun Breathing Empath
quote: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living.
bio: You meet cruelty with steadfast courage and compassion. You believe even enemies deserve dignity in defeat, and your unwavering kindness inspires everyone around you.

name: Ken Kaneki
title: The One-Eyed Ghoul Centipede
quote: I'm not the protagonist of a novel... I'm a normal college student. But if you were to write a story with me as the lead, it would certainly be a tragedy.
bio: Caught between opposing worlds, you endure agonizing internal conflict. When pushed to the brink, you conquer weakness and embrace complexity with chilling elegance.

name: Loid Forger ('Twilight')
title: The Master Infiltrator
quote: A world where children don't have to cry... that was the whole reason I became a spy in the first place.
bio: A consummate professional capable of solving any crisis with cold methodology, yet secretly longing for the peaceful warmth of a real home and family.

name: Denji
title: The Chainsaw Devil Fiend
quote: Everybody's got these grand dreams. But what about toast with jam? Isn't wanting a normal life good enough?!
bio: Raw, chaotic, and gloriously authentic. You don't posture with pretentious philosophies—you fight fiercely for genuine human connection and simple joys in a mad world.

name: Erwin Smith
title: The Survey Corps Commander
quote: My soldiers, rage! My soldiers, scream! My soldiers, fight!
bio: You possess magnetic leadership and dare to take colossal gambles where others freeze. You inspire thousands to march through hell because you lead from the very front.
